9:t_1:4.en:
$$キング$$
「With this, all our efforts and our very existence are reduced to nothing...」

9:t_1:5.en:
$$キング$$
「With this, the history of humanity comes to an end...」

9:t_1:6.en:
$$キング$$
「But at least a future of despair can be avoided...」

9:t_10:4.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「This scenario has no $$Ｄトレーダー$$, but Scenario Demo 10 is included just in case.」

10:t_000:1.en:
$$レイアム$$
「$cWe've lost contact with all ships. Also, the $$地球連邦軍$$ fleets have been destroyed or have withdrawn in every area.」

10:t_000:2.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「The $$連邦軍$$ are now worn down, both by the destruction of their main fleet, which was under the thumb of 《$$クロノ$$》, and by the fighting with $$ネオ・ジオン$$.」

10:t_000:3.en:
$$キャシー$$
「To think we'd have to face a new enemy in this situation...」

10:t_000:4.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Let's do what we can now. At the very least, we will hold this area to the death.」

10:t_000:5.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「Three minutes until contact with the enemy $$サイデリアル$$...」

10:t_000:6.en:
$$テッサ$$
「The absolute defense line for this area is right where we are now.」

10:t_000:7.en:
$$テッサ$$
(The Earth Absolute Defense Plan... If that had been carried out, we could have dealt with a situation like this...)

10:t_000:8.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「All units, you heard it. If they break through here, the enemy forces will descend to Earth.」

10:t_000:9.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「If that happened, the Earth would...」

10:t_000:12.en:
$$リディ$$
「But even if we win, it's only one area...」

10:t_000:15.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Even so, all we can do is fight.」

10:t_000:17.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Are you ready, you guys...! Here they come!」

10:t_001:1.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Be careful! There are even more units waiting behind them!」

10:t_001:2.en:
$$甲児$$
「Then we'll just drag them out and smash them!」

10:t_001:6.en:
$n
「I can't afford to whine...! Let's go!」

10:t_003:1.en:
$$弁慶$$
「Damn! How much strength does the enemy have!」

10:t_003:2.en:
$$アルト$$
「That conspicuous ship...! Is that the flagship!?」

10:t_004:1.en:
$$スズネ$$
「The owner of the $$沈黙の巨蟹$$ 《$$スフィア$$》...!」

10:t_004:2.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「My subordinates will deal with you. ...Let's go, $$ストラウス$$.」

10:t_005:0.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「They're breaking through the defense line!」

10:t_005:1.en:
$$テッサ$$
「All units, turn around! Pursue them!」

10:t_006:1.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Are you trying to hold us here!?」

10:t_006:2.en:
$$尸刻$$
「The mission I was given is to eliminate you.」

10:t_006:4.en:
$$尸刻$$
「My name is $$尸刻$$... I serve as deputy commander of $$鬼宿$$.」

10:t_006:5.en:
$$宗介$$
「In short, you're part of that $$尸空#pilot$$'s gang...!」

10:t_006:8.en:
$$尸刻$$
「If you had simply decayed away in that person's mercy, it would have been better...」

10:t_006:9.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Sorry to disappoint you! We chose to live toward the future!」

10:t_006:10.en:
$$甲児$$
「By beating those who go after Earth on their own selfish logic, like you!」

10:t_006:11.en:
$$尸刻$$
「...That person's sorrow will never reach you...」

10:t_006:12.en:
$$尸刻$$
「All units, scatter. Carry out the mission.」

10:t_006:14.en:
$$隼人$$
「With these guys in the way, we can't even chase after the rest of them! Let's do this!」

10:t_006:15.en:
$$テッサ$$
「All units, be careful! The mass-produced units they use show improved performance over the ones we've fought so far!」

10:t_006:16.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Our target is the enemy commander who calls herself $$尸刻$$! Concentrate your attacks!」

10:t_006:17.en:
$$尸刻$$
「The time has come for you to learn that you were being protected... Your defeat is inevitable.」

10:t_007:0.en:
$$尸刻$$
「...I see. It's no wonder the $$ジェミニス$$ can't win.」

10:t_007:1.en:
$$尸刻$$
「But the minimum mission has been carried out. All units, withdraw.」

10:t_008:0.en:
$$尸刻$$
「...I see. It's no wonder the $$ジェミニス$$ can't win.」

10:t_008:1.en:
$$尸刻$$
「But the minimum mission has been carried out. I am withdrawing.」

10:t_009:0.en:
$$レイアム$$
「The enemy leader's unit has withdrawn. ...Shall we pursue, Captain?」

10:t_009:1.en:
$$オットー$$
「Which one? That woman, or the fleet that descended?」

10:t_009:3.en:
$$テッサ$$
「...Even so, we must keep fighting.」

10:t_010:1.en:
$$テッサ$$
「The power we hold is for protecting peace. We are not permitted to abandon that responsibility.」

10:t_010:5.en:
$$テッサ$$
「It is that we have not lost the will to fight.」
